ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Job Role and Responsibility: AMD, Inc., is hiring MTS Network Engineer to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, implementation, and support of the company’s global network infrastructure. Design, develop, and implement automation workflows to streamline network operations using tools such as Ansible, Python, or Terraform. Collaborate with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities aligned with business objectives and network architecture standards. Develop scripts to automate data collection for network performance monitoring and reporting. Ensure a metrics-driven approach to network uptime, resiliency, performance, latency, and end-user experience. Evaluate emerging networking technologies and assess their impact on infrastructure and user experience. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including security, compute, procurement, finance, vendors, customers, and firewall technologies to support network operations. Drive innovation with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and infrastructure strategy. Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives, technology evaluations, and implementation decisions. Support budget planning, tracking, and adherence. Assist with preparation of executive-level presentations. Apply knowledge of networking, electronics, and engineering principles to the design, development, and testing of systems. Multiple openings. Qualified applicants click “APPLY NOW” button to apply online. Travel required: NO Qualifications: Degree required Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. Qualifications: Amount and type of experience required: Two (2) years of experience in the job offered or closely related engineering role. Alternate combination of education and experience: Employer will alternatively accept a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field and four (4) years of progressive, post-baccalaureate experience in job offered or closely related engineering role. Specific skills required: The following skills are required: Position requires two (2) years of experience in the following: End-to-end project planning and implementation of large-scale LAN/WAN and MPLS network and internet systems; Working with firewalls, including Cisco ASA, Palo Alto, or equivalent firewall technologies, including troubleshooting using logs; Utilizing HP ProCurve, Dell Force10 switches, Aruba Mobility Controllers, and Cisco Nexus switches; Network architecture, design, implementation, and troubleshooting in large-scale enterprise environments; Designing, configuring, and maintaining complex routed LAN and WAN environments; Developing and maintaining networking standards, documentation, and deployment methodologies; Working across networking and infrastructure domains, including data center and cloud networking; Full networking stack experience including routing, switching, WAN, firewalls, and data center technologies; Networking protocols, Linux networking, open-source tools, vendor platforms, and implementation best practices; and Network automation using software-based approaches. Certification Requirement: Cisco certification in Cisco Enterprise Network Core Technologies (ENCOR) or Cisco Security Core Technologies (SCOR) Preferred Skills: N/A Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
